subject: Real Estate Transfer Fee
overview: The Medford City Council established a municipal stabilization fund, approved a 65-unit mixed-use special permit on Winchester Street, and advanced a leaf blower ordinance on first reading. After extensive and contentious public testimony from residents and homeowners, the council voted to send a proposed real estate transfer fee Home Rule petition to committee for further study.

items.title: Remembrances, Records, and Committee Reports
items.summary: The council approved resolutions of condolence for Joseph Rossetti and James Burns, approved the minutes of February 20, 2024, and adopted four committee reports.

items.title: Establishment of General Stabilization Fund
items.summary: Approved the establishment of a municipal stabilization fund under General Laws Chapter 40, Section 5B, following council debate and resident questions regarding fiscal transparency and city budget oversight.

items.title: Special Permit Signage: Raising Cane's
items.summary: Opened a public hearing on an application for additional on-premises signage at 760 Fellsway and voted to continue the hearing to April 2, 2024.

items.title: Special Permit and Site Plan: 96-104 Winchester Street
items.summary: Approved a planned development special permit and site plan review for a 65-unit residential and commercial development at 96-104 Winchester Street, with a condition prohibiting occupants from obtaining residential on-street parking permits.

items.title: MBTA Plan for Accessible Transit Infrastructure
items.summary: Approved the MBTA's proposed accessibility improvements and bus stop adjustments under the Plan for Accessible Transit Infrastructure following a project briefing.

items.title: Real Estate Transfer Fee Home Rule Petition
items.summary: Referred a resolution to draft a Home Rule petition for a real estate transfer fee to the Planning and Permitting Committee, following hours of debate and substantial public testimony regarding housing affordability, homeowner protections, and tax impacts.

items.title: Leaf Blower Ordinance First Reading
items.summary: Approved the leaf blower ordinance on first reading with an amendment striking the word "continuous" from operational restrictions in Section 38-58.

items.title: Tabled Papers and Election Department Name Update
items.summary: Tabled the proposed budget ordinance, linkage fee updates, and papers 24-052 through 24-054 to March 19, and approved a resolution updating the formal title of the Election Department.
